title: 报表面板改写后的六行：ja-JP 和 es-ES 译文仍是旧的开发者含义，需要译者过一遍
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a shipped-text defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7120950453). Source: noted in the body of PR #36814 (#36447).
Blocked-by: #36814

## What happens

PR #36814 rewords six rows of the Studio report panel into business terms in English, and zh-CN follows the new meaning. The ja-JP and es-ES values of those six rows still translate the old developer wording, so once #36814 lands those two locales say something different from en and zh-CN.

reach: noted by the PR, not measured in a browser. It reaches every builder working in ja-JP or es-ES.

## Expected

The ja-JP and es-ES values of the six rows carry the new English meaning.

## Acceptance

- The six rows in the ja-JP and es-ES bundles are re-translated from the new English, and the PR names them.
- Any locale-completeness check stays green.

Dedupe: open issues for the report panel wording return only #36447 (in flight; en and zh-CN).
